name: Nabisco Norcross Distribution Center - Norcross GA

fieldNotes.locate: Roster gave APPROXIMATE (city-level) coordinates. Resolved via web research (Businessyab, Chamber of Commerce, Becknell Industrial listing) to 6300 Brook Hollow Pkwy, Norcross GA 30071, then geocoded via Google Geocoding API to a ROOFTOP point at 33.9214824, -84.2181224. Locked to the warehouse there.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Open paved driveway off Brook Hollow Parkway into a front car-parking lot and on to the NE truck court. No barrier arm, sliding gate, or checkpoint pinch-point visible in satellite or Street View (2025-12).
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth at the entrance. The building has an office front on the SW corner but no separate gate-side booth.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: No gate, so no remote check-in inferred.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Moderate distribution warehouse; NE face shows a dock apron with roughly 10-14 dock-door positions and a few trailers. Band 10-25, count ~13 - flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropArea: NE truck court holds only a handful of untethered trailers; small count, band 0-10 - flagged uncertain (court partly shadowed).
fieldNotes.dropYard: No dedicated standalone trailer-storage lot; the modest NE truck court doubles as dock staging, so dropYard left false.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Short approach - the front lot and truck court give room for only 1-2 trucks before the docks.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock doors observed only on the NE face; no second distinct dock bank, so shipRcvSeparate false - flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Facility sits in the dense Norcross / Atlanta-metro industrial corridor along Brook Hollow Parkway, surrounded by large warehouses - Urban.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Front lot and NE truck court provide some inside-property holding space before the docks.
